latestFinalStatusFix.rootCause: P24 returned HTTP 200 with transaksi_member.status=2 and ref_id=RSA3. The application only parsed top-level status and unconditionally stored accepted dispatches as pending, despite the user receiving DANA.
latestFinalStatusFix.fix: Parse nested transaksi_member and numeric success status; apply immediate success using the callback settlement path. Preserve final P24 attempt status against delayed pending responses and acknowledge database errors instead of reporting false success.
latestFinalStatusFix.repair: Dry-run then apply reconcile_p24_app_success for this exact invoice using the stored HTTP 200 success response and matching reference. No PAY request or fabricated callback was sent.
latestFinalStatusFix.tests: go test ./... passed locally. Isolated PostgreSQL tests cover immediate nested success, stored-success reconciliation, wrong-reference rejection, dry-run safety, duplicate callbacks, delayed pending acknowledgements, no resend, and existing refund idempotency.
latestFinalStatusFix.providerCostNote: The stored response supplies biaya_perkiraan but no explicit actual price. The fix does not turn that estimate into a provider-wallet debit or invent an opening provider balance.
latestFinalStatusFix.userPurchaseSuccessEvidence: User confirmed DANA received; stored authenticated P24 response reports status 2 and a receipt reference. Read-only SALDO reports 199000.

latestCheckoutPreflightFix.symptom: DANA checkout waited and returned a generic order creation error.
latestCheckoutPreflightFix.evidence: Production Nginx recorded POST /v1/app/orders returning 502 at 21:03:19 and 21:03:54 WIB after the backend closed the upstream response. P24 catalog requests timed out at 30 seconds, matching the backend HTTP write timeout. No new DANA order or pending provider attempt was recorded.
latestCheckoutPreflightFix.fix: Limit live catalog validation to 8 seconds, below the 30-second HTTP write timeout; return JSON HTTP 503 with an actionable message before creating an order or debiting funds. Do not bypass live validation or automatically retry purchases.
latestCheckoutPreflightFix.tests: Unit tests verify request deadlines, shorter caller deadlines, and exact DANA SKU selection. Disposable PostgreSQL schema plus a mock provider verify timeout creates no order, normal DANA creation prices 100000 + 1000 as 101000 without charging, and existing fulfillment/callback idempotency tests pass.
latestCheckoutPreflightFix.readOnlyProviderCheck: SALDO returned HTTP 200 in 0.66 seconds with balance 300000; PRODUK DANA returned HTTP 200 in 1.79 seconds with fee_tambahan 1000. These checks do not guarantee subsequent provider availability.
latestCheckoutPreflightFix.livePurchaseTest: Not run: user explicitly chose to test personally.
